dedupe_keys.name: ademe dpe open data french energy performance diagnostics for dwellings and non residential buildings

description: The Diagnostic de Performance Energétique (DPE) records the energy use and greenhouse gas emissions of a dwelling or building together with its characteristics, such as floor area, orientation, walls, windows and materials, and its heating, hot water and ventilation equipment. ADEME has collected DPEs since 2013 and publishes them as open data on data.ademe.fr. After the reform of 1 July 2021, which applied the 3CL method to all dwellings, moved from three to five energy uses and added a greenhouse gas threshold to the label, the main datasets are existing dwellings since July 2021 (about 15.7 million records, updated weekly, last on 23 September 2026), new dwellings (about 1.4 million) and non-residential buildings (about 567,000), with older pre-reform files for dwellings (10.7 million) and non-residential buildings. Coverage: France. Access: free download and data-fair API. Licence: Licence Ouverte 2.0. Caveats: pre- and post-2021 methods are not directly comparable, and diagnostics are made at transactions and rentals, not for the whole stock. Simulation uses are building-level characteristics and energy classes for stock models, renovation targeting and heat demand mapping. Related records: EP-Online in the Netherlands and the England and Wales EPC register.
